name: Perhentian Turtle Project (PTP)
summary: Monitors and protects sea turtles in the Perhentian Islands Marine Park using photo-identification and raises awareness in local communities.
beneficiaries: Sea turtles of the Perhentian Islands; Kampung Pasir Hantu fishing community

contact.address: Project house, Kampung Pasir Hantu (Fishermen Village), Perhentian Islands, Terengganu (no postal address published)
